#  Caching videos Stay organized with collections  Save and categorize content based on your preferences. 

_This page applies to**Apigee** and **Apigee hybrid**._

_View[ Apigee Edge](https://docs.apigee.com/api-platform/get-started/what-apigee-edge) documentation._ ![](https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/i/googlematerialicons/help/v13/gm_grey-24dp/1x/gm_help_gm_grey_24dp.png)

Watch the following videos to learn more about the [ ResponseCache](https://docs.cloud.google.com/apigee/docs/api-platform/reference/policies/response-cache-policy) policy.

**Note:** The following videos were recorded with a previous version of the Apigee UI; however, the concepts are still valid. Video | Description  
---|---  
[Improve API performance using API caching in Apigee](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hkBRz8jF4fk) | Understand the advantages of using API caching on Apigee.  
[Skip cache data using Apigee](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=eY32mk4zshA) | Learn how to skip cache data based on runtime conditions so that you can selectively cache API response data based on requirements.  
[Expire cache data using Response Cache policy](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5m7_RVCI6vc) | Learn how to expire the cache using cache expiration settings in the policy.  
[Dynamic API caching using Cache Keys](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TCY0otgN3pk) | Learn how to cache API responses dynamically based on API Request variables in Response Cache Policy and Cache Keys.
